warningMessage: Space Engineers uses its official Dedicated Server Manager, which Synix must keep visible. The first time it opens, select Local/Console, choose Continue to server configuration, enter the server and world settings, and select Save & start. Use the manager for advanced settings, worlds, mods, administrators, and its console. Synix keeps this instance under the server's Instance folder. The foreground Local/Console mode does not require administrator rights; creating a Windows service does. The official requirements are .NET Framework 4.8 or newer, Visual C++ Redistributables 2013 and 2017, at least 6 GB of system RAM, and UDP port 27016 allowed through Windows Firewall and forwarded in the router for Internet players. Official guide: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

launchBehavior.readyMessage: The official Space Engineers manager will remain visible. Select Local/Console and use Save & start to launch the server.
